_comment: Drop-in replacement for my_zodiac_ai/.claude/settings.json — preserves Serena reminders + adds plugin-managed hooks. Project-specific UserPromptSubmit (Serena prompt reminder) is kept inline; everything else delegated to zodiac-hooks-pack.

enabledPlugins._comment_sdd: speckit + speckit-product-forge are SpecKit CLI extensions, NOT Claude plugins. Install separately: 'specify init' (github/spec-kit), then 'specify extension add product-forge --from https://github.com/VaiYav/speckit-product-forge/archive/refs/heads/main.zip'

hooks._comment: All Edit/Write hooks (block-sensitive, eslint, tsc, prisma, gsap) come from zodiac-hooks-pack via plugin.json. Only project-unique hooks live here.
